events.title: Please Be Careful: Fake Orion Blue is Still Appearing
events.summary: We need to warn everyone again. The scammers impersonating Orion Blue are still active, and we’re now seeing the same pattern repeatedly. They usually approach people through Discord, often using compromised accounts. They may say something like: “We’re trying to play Orion Blue, but we need one more player.” They then send you a fake Orion Blue website and ask you to download the game. DO NOT DOWNLOAD IT. events.title: Important Security Notice
events.summary: ⚠️ Important Security Notice Hello everyone, We’d like to share a quick security reminder with our community. We have recently received reports of unofficial accounts contacting players and offering access to Orion Blue test builds. To stay safe, please only trust Orion Blue information and test invitations shared through our official channels: • Steam – the official Orion Blue Steam page • Discord – https://discord.gg/y42HgC4NKR • X – https://x.com/ExlixStudi64894 Official Orion Blue game build
